LanguageData.Gun_Skorpion_SA_Vz82_RWP.label: Skorpion vz.82
LanguageData.Gun_Skorpion_SA_Vz82_RWP.description: The Skorpion vz.82 is a compact automatic firearm known for its versatility and ease of handling. Designed with a retractable wire stock, it's ideal for close-quarters combat, offering burst fire capabilities to quickly suppress threats. Despite its small size, it delivers a reliable rate of fire with improved accuracy, making it a favorite for both sidearm roles and primary self-defense.
